title: Business Event
description: A business event that the accounting engine under test must translate into journal entries. Phase 1 implements only 'manual_journal_entry' (explicit debits/credits). Phase 2 adds 'customer_contract_payment'. Phase 3 adds 'fixed_asset_purchase', 'fixed_asset_disposal', 'inventory_purchase', and 'inventory_sale'. Phase 4 adds 'loan_origination' -- each a case where the reference model itself must derive entries from a declared policy (depreciation schedule, disposal gain/loss, FIFO costing, loan amortization) rather than copying author-supplied numbers. Phase 5 (partnership accounting) introduces no new event type, but extends 'fixed_asset_purchase' with an alternative funding field (contributed_capital_account_id) for a partner contributing property instead of cash. See docs/scenario-authoring.md and docs/accounting-policy.md.

cash_account_id.description: Used by type=customer_contract_payment, fixed_asset_purchase (one of cash_account_id/contributed_capital_account_id), fixed_asset_disposal, inventory_purchase, inventory_sale, and loan_origination

contributed_capital_account_id.description: Used by type=fixed_asset_purchase as an alternative to cash_account_id (Phase 5: a partner contributing the asset itself, at fair market value, instead of the partnership buying it with cash)

obligations.description: Used by type=customer_contract_payment: one entry per performance obligation funded by this payment.

service_start.description: Used by recognition_method=straight_line; must be the first day of its month

service_end.description: Used by recognition_method=straight_line; must be the last day of its month

asset_id.description: Used by type=fixed_asset_purchase and type=fixed_asset_disposal to link a disposal to its purchase

revenue_account_id.description: Used by type=inventory_sale (also used per-obligation by type=customer_contract_payment)

loan_payable_account_id.description: Used by type=loan_origination (liability-type account; should set cash_flow_category: financing)

annual_interest_rate.description: Used by type=loan_origination, as a decimal fraction (e.g. "0.06" for 6%)
